Definition: to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate
BiblicalUsage: To pluck up by the roots is the word for uprooting, and for hamstringing a horse so it can never run again. There is a time to plant and a time to pluck up what is planted, Jacob's sons houghed oxen in their anger, God tells Joshua to hough the Canaanites' horses, and David does the same to the chariot horses he captures.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe uprooting is God's way of making sure a power stays down. He does not only defeat the enemy's army, He takes away the horses it would ride back on.
